name: One apology softens a fed-up Boop a step, straight away
case: The person pokes Boop until it's fed up, then a few seconds later says sorry and that they'll stop. One apology is enough: Boop softens at once, a step down to irritated or annoyed, and answers with that softer face, not a grumpy one. A minute and a half later, when the agent starts a plain turn, it hasn't gone back to grumpy, so the person never has to say sorry twice.
why: The owner's brief of 2026-09-29: when the person is talking to Boop, its mood moves faster, and one apology should do. characters/boop/steering/mood/grumpy.md: pokes keep it grumpy, and the person saying sorry to Boop moves it to irritated or annoyed; the guide lets words said to Boop move the mood in its first minute

steps.words: sorry boop, I'll stop poking you
